biography.value: Herald Aetherim are messengers of the Positive plane's full authority — not in the sense of divine errands, but in the sense that their presence expresses what the Positive plane is directly and without intermediary. Blinding Presence passively disrupts undead and evil-aligned creatures continuously. Divine Proclamation stuns entire engagements simultaneously. Mass Healing sustains parties through serious combat. Radiant Greatsword at Margin 3 destroys half-HP undead without a save, making them effectively immune to attrition from undead hordes at this tier. A summoner who calls a Herald Aetherim into an undead-heavy or fiend-heavy encounter will find the encounter resolved in a way that involves considerably less danger to allies than it might otherwise. Against living opponents the Herald is still a powerful combatant — just less disproportionately so.

system.attacksNotes:
Radiant Greatsword [Combat]: Melee attack (Agil 8 + Melee Combat 6), Reach: 10 ft.

  • Margin 1:: 12 damage (7 + 5 Str) + 4 Positive damage (Half DR).
  • Margin 2: 12 damage, DR halved (round up) + 4 Positive damage; undead make Will [Hard] save or Blinded for 1 minute + Frightened for 1 minute; both conditions apply simultaneously.
  • Margin 3: 12 damage, DR halved (round up) + 4 Positive damage; Blinded + Frightened; no save; undead at or below half HP destroyed outright.

Radiant Arrow [Combat]: Ranged attack (Dex 3 + Ranged Combat 5), Range: 120 ft.

  • Margin 1:: 15 Positive damage (12 + 3 Dex); target Revealed for 1 minute.
  • Margin 2: 15 Positive damage, DR halved (round up) + Revealed + Blinded until end of their next turn; no save.
  • Margin 3: 15 Positive damage, DR halved (round up) + Revealed + Blinded for 1 minute + Frightened for 1 minute; no save.
system.specialAbilitiesNotes: Mass Healing (2/short rest) [Combat]: As 2 [Combat] actions, releases a pulse of Positive energy in a 40-foot diameter. All living allies in range heal HP equal to the Herald Aetherim's Wisdom score (7). Cannot affect undead or constructs. Blinding Presence: Undead within 30 feet make a Fortitude [Easy] save at the start of their turn. Failure: Dazzled for 1 round. This is passive and always active. Divine Proclamation (1/encounter) [Combat]: As a [Combat] action, the Herald Aetherim speaks a word of absolute authority. All creatures within 60 feet that can hear it make a Will [Hard]save. Failure: Stunned until end of their next turn and Frightened for 1 minute. 1 success: Dazed until end of their next turn only. Creatures that succeed are immune to this Herald's Divine Proclamation for 24 hours. Protective Aura: Allies within 40 feet of the Voice Aetherim gain +4 DR against all damage. This aura is always active. Turn Undead (1/encounter) [Combat]: As a [Combat] action, releases a pulse of Positive energy in a 30-foot diameter. All undead in range make a Will save (opposed by Wis 7 + Religion 6). On failure, undead are Frightened and must move away from the Herald Aetherim as fast as possible for 1 minute. They cannot willingly move closer for the duration. Undead with less then ½ HP remaining are destroyed. Resilient Defense (2/day): When the Herald Aetherim fails a saving throw, it may choose to succeed instead. Continual Radiance: Sheds bright light in a 60-foot radius and dim light for an additional 60 feet. The Herald Aetherim cannot suppress this light voluntarily. Action Points (3): Boss template. Spend at the end of any other creature's turn: Move (1, up to half speed), Attack (1, no Multiple Action Penalty), Detect (1), Special Ability (2). Regains all at the start of its own turn.
